marketBrief.headline: Nasdaq rebounds 1.09% to 24,579 after Thursday's rout; Dow slips 237 points
marketBrief.summary: The Nasdaq Composite closed up 1.09% at 24,579.42 and the S&P 500 rose 0.31% to 7,376.86, per CNBC's live coverage. The Dow fell 237.33 points to 51,285.73. The week still closed lower for all three indexes. DraftKings was the day's biggest casualty after a Q3 miss and a profit-outlook cut. Friday's earnings slate was led by Moderna, Humana and Vistra, which all reported before the open.
bullets: Nasdaq Composite +1.09% to 24,579.42; S&P 500 +0.31% to 7,376.86; Dow -237.33 points (-0.46%) to 51,285.73 (CNBC live updates).
Week: Nasdaq -3.37%, S&P 500 -2.68%, Dow -0.94% (Investrade closing recap).
VIX fell 15.73% on Friday after jumping 69.7% on Thursday (Yahoo Finance quote page; Zacks via Yahoo Finance).
DraftKings closed near $17.44, down about 25.9% after a Q3 miss and a cut to its 2026 profit outlook (GuruFocus).
Moderna raised 2026 revenue growth guidance to 15%-25%; Humana raised adjusted EPS guidance to at least $9.50; Vistra raised its EBITDA guidance midpoint (company releases).
